verses.en: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre, non de la part des hommes, ni par un homme, mais par Jésus-Christ et Dieu le Père, qui l''a ressuscité des morts,

verses.en: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.fr: et tous les frères qui sont avec moi, aux Eglises de la Galatie:
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከሙታንም ባነሣው በእግዚአብሔር አብ ሐዋርያ የሆነ እንጂ ከሰዎች ወይም በሰው ያልሆነ ጳውሎስ ከእኔም ጋር ያሉት ወንድሞች ሁሉ፥ ወደ ገላትያ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት፤

verses.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.fr: que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu le Père et de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታችንም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.fr: qui s''est donné lui-même pour nos péchés, afin de nous arracher du présent siècle mauvais, selon la volonté de notre Dieu et Père,
verses.am: ክፉ ከሆነ ከአሁኑ ዓለም ያድነን ዘንድ እንደ አምላካችንና እንደ አባታችን ፈቃድ ስለ ኃጢአታችን ራሱን ሰጠ።

verses.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: qui soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ለአብ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.fr: Je m''étonne que vous vous détourniez si promptement de celui qui vous a appelés par la grâce de Christ, pour passer à un autre Evangile.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ጸጋ እናንተን ከጠራችሁ ከእርሱ ወደ ልዩ ወንጌል እንዲህ ፈጥናችሁ እንዴት እንዳለፋችሁ እደነቃለሁ፤

verses.en: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.fr: Non pas qu''il y ait un autre Evangile, mais il y a des gens qui vous troublent, et qui veulent renverser l''Evangile de Christ.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ሌላ ወንጌል አይደለም፤ የሚያናውጡአችሁ የክርስቶስንም ወንጌል ሊያጣምሙ የሚወዱ አንዳንዶች አሉ እንጂ።

verses.en: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.fr: Mais, quand nous-mêmes, quand un ange du ciel annoncerait un autre Evangile que celui que nous vous avons prêché, qu''il soit anathème!
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኛ ብንሆን ወይም ከሰማይ መልአክ፥ ከሰበክንላችሁ ወንጌል የሚለይ ወንጌልን ቢሰብክላችሁ፥ የተረገመ ይሁን።

verses.en: As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.fr: Nous l''avons dit précédemment, et je le répète à cette heure: si quelqu''un vous annonce un autre Evangile que celui que vous avez reçu, qu''il soit anathème!
verses.am: አስቀድመን እንዳልን እንዲሁ አሁን ሁለተኛ እላለሁ፥ ከተቀበላችሁት የተለየውን ማንም ቢሰብክላችሁ የተረገመ ይሁን።

verses.en: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, est-ce la faveur des hommes que je désire, ou celle de Dieu? Est-ce que je cherche à plaire aux hommes? Si je plaisais encore aux hommes, je ne serais pas serviteur de Christ.
verses.am: ሰውን ወይስ እግዚአብሔርን አሁን እሺ አሰኛለሁን? ወይም ሰውን ደስ ላሰኝ እፈልጋለሁን? አሁን ሰውን ደስ ባሰኝ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ባልሆንሁም።

verses.en: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.fr: Je vous déclare, frères, que l''Evangile qui a été annoncé par moi n''est pas de l''homme;
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በእኔ የተሰበከ ወንጌል እንደ ሰው እንዳይደለ አስታውቃችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: car je ne l''ai ni reçu ni appris d''un homme, mais par une révélation de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ገልጦልኛል እንጂ እኔ ከሰው አልተቀበልሁትም አልተማርሁትምም።

verses.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.fr: Vous avez su, en effet, quelle était autrefois ma conduite dans le judaïsme, comment je persécutais à outrance et ravageais l''Eglise de Dieu,
verses.am: በአይሁድ ሥርዓት በፊት እንዴት እንደ ኖርሁ ሰምታችኋልና፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ያለ ልክ አሳድድና አጠፋ ነበር፥

verses.en: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.fr: et comment j''étais plus avancé dans le judaïsme que beaucoup de ceux de mon âge et de ma nation, étant animé d''un zèle excessif pour les traditions de mes pères.
verses.am: ለአባቶችም ወግ ከመጠን ይልቅ እየቀናሁ በወገኔ ዘንድ በዘመኔ ካሉት ብዙዎችን በአይሁድ ሥርዓት እበልጥ ነበር።

verses.en: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.fr: Mais, lorsqu''il plut à celui qui m''avait mis à part dès le sein de ma mère, et qui m''a appelé par sa grâce,
verses.am: ከእኔም በፊት ሐዋርያት ወደ ነበሩት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አልወጣሁም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ዓረብ አገር ሄድሁ እንደ ገናም ወደ ደማስቆ ተመለስሁ።

verses.en: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.fr: de révéler en moi son Fils, afin que je l''annonçasse parmi les païens, aussitôt, je ne consultai ni la chair ni le sang,
verses.am: ከእኔም በፊት ሐዋርያት ወደ ነበሩት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አልወጣሁም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ዓረብ አገር ሄድሁ እንደ ገናም ወደ ደማስቆ ተመለስሁ።

verses.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.fr: et je ne montai point à Jérusalem vers ceux qui furent apôtres avant moi, mais je partis pour l''Arabie. Puis je revins encore à Damas.
verses.am: ከዚህ ወዲያ ከሦስት ዓመት በኋላ ኬፋን ልጠይቅ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጥቼ ከእርሱ ጋር አሥራ አምስት ቀን ሰነበትሁ፤

verses.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.fr: Trois ans plus tard, je montai à Jérusalem pour faire la connaissance de Céphas, et je demeurai quinze jours chez lui.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከጌታ ወንድም ከያዕቆብ በቀር ከሐዋርያት ሌላ አላየሁም።

verses.en: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
verses.fr: Mais je ne vis aucun autre des apôtres, si ce n''est Jacques, le frère du Seigneur.
verses.am: ስለምፅፍላችሁም ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሐሰት አልናገርም።

verses.en: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.fr: Dans ce que je vous écris, voici, devant Dieu, je ne mens point.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ ሶርያና ወደ ኪልቅያ አገር መጣሁ።

verses.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.fr: J''allai ensuite dans les contrées de la Syrie et de la Cilicie.
verses.am: በክርስቶስም ያሉት የይሁዳ ማኅበሮች ፊቴን አያውቁም ነበር፤

verses.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
verses.fr: Or, j''étais inconnu de visage aux Eglises de Judée qui sont en Christ;
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ቀድሞ እኛን ያሳድድ የነበረ፥ እርሱ በፊት ያጠፋው የነበረውን ሃይማኖት አሁን ይሰብካል ተብሎ ሲነገር ይሰሙ ነበር፤

verses.en: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.fr: seulement, elles avaient entendu dire: Celui qui autrefois nous persécutait annonce maintenant la foi qu''il s''efforçait alors de détruire.
verses.am: ስለ እኔም እግዚአብሔርን ያከብሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And they glorified God in me.
verses.fr: Et elles glorifiaient Dieu à mon sujet.
verses.am: ስለ እኔም እግዚአብሔርን ያከብሩ ነበር።

verses.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
verses.fr: Quatorze ans après, je montai de nouveau à Jérusalem avec Barnabas, ayant aussi pris Tite avec moi;
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ከአሥራ አራት ዓመት በኋላ ከበርናባስ ጋር ቲቶን ደግሞ ይዤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሁለተኛ ወጣሁ፤

verses.en: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
verses.fr: et ce fut d''après une révélation que j''y montai. Je leur exposai l''Evangile que je prêche parmi les païens, je l''exposai en particulier à ceux qui sont les plus considérés, afin de ne pas courir ou avoir couru en vain.
verses.am: እንደ ተገለጠልኝም ወጣሁ፤ ምናልባትም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥ ወይም በከንቱ ሮጬ እንዳልሆን በአሕዛብ መካከል የምሰብከውን ወንጌል አስታወቅኋቸው፤ ዋኖች ግን መስለው ለሚታዩ ለብቻቸው አስታወቅኋቸው።

verses.en: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.fr: Mais Tite, qui était avec moi, et qui était Grec, ne fut pas même contraint de se faire circoncire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእኔ ጋር የነበረ ቲቶ እንኳ የግሪክ ሰው ሲሆን ይገረዝ ዘንድ ግድ አላሉትም፤

verses.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.fr: Et cela, à cause des faux frères qui s''étaient furtivement introduits et glissés parmi nous, pour épier la liberté que nous avons en Jésus-Christ, avec l''intention de nous asservir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ባሪያዎች ሊያደርጉን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለንን አርነታችንን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሾልከው በስውር ስለ ገቡ ስለ ሐሰተኞች ወንድሞች ነበረ።

verses.en: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.fr: Nous ne leur cédâmes pas un instant et nous résistâmes à leurs exigences, afin que la vérité de l''Evangile fût maintenue parmi vous.
verses.am: የወንጌልም እውነት በእናንተ ዘንድ ጸንቶ እንዲኖር ለአንድ ሰዓት እንኳ ለቅቀን አልተገዛንላቸውም።

verses.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont les plus considérés-quels qu''ils aient été jadis, cela ne m''importe pas: Dieu ne fait point acception de personnes, - ceux qui sont les plus considérés ne m''imposèrent rien.
verses.am: አለቆች የመሰሉት ግን፥ በፊት ማን እንደ ነበሩ አይገደኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር የሰውን ፊት አይቶ አያደላም፤ አለቆች የመሰሉት አንዳች እንኳ አልጨመሩልኝምና፥

verses.en: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
verses.fr: Au contraire, voyant que l''Evangile m''avait été confié pour les incirconcis, comme à Pierre pour les circoncis, -
verses.am: ተመልሰው ግን ጴጥሮስ ለተገረዙት የሆነው ወንጌል አደራ እንደ ተሰጠው እንዲሁ ለእኔ ላልተገረዙት የሆነው ወንጌል አደራ እንደ ተሰጠኝ አዩ፤

verses.en: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.fr: car celui qui a fait de Pierre l''apôtre des circoncis a aussi fait de moi l''apôtre des païens, -
verses.am: ለተገረዙት ሐዋርያ እንዲሆን ለጴጥሮስ የሠራለት፥ ለእኔ ደግሞ ለአሕዛብ ሐዋርያ እንድሆን ሠርቶአልና።

verses.en: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.fr: et ayant reconnu la grâce qui m''avait été accordée, Jacques, Céphas et Jean, qui sont regardés comme des colonnes, me donnèrent, à moi et à Barnabas, la main d''association, afin que nous allassions, nous vers les païens, et eux vers les circoncis.
verses.am: ደግሞ የተሰጠኝን ጸጋ አውቀው፥ አዕማድ መስለው የሚታዩ ያዕቆብና ኬፋ ዮሐንስም እኛ ወደ አሕዛብ እነርሱም ወደ ተገረዙት ይሄዱ ዘንድ ለእኔና ለበርናባስ ቀኝ እጃቸውን ሰጡን፤

verses.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.fr: Ils nous recommandèrent seulement de nous souvenir des pauvres, ce que j''ai bien eu soin de faire.
verses.am: ድሆችን እናስብ ዘንድ ብቻ ለመኑን፥ ይህንም ደግሞ ላደርግ ተጋሁ።

verses.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.fr: Mais lorsque Céphas vint à Antioche, je lui résistai en face, parce qu''il était répréhensible.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኬፋ ወደ አንጾኪያ በመጣ ጊዜ ፊት ለፊት ተቃወምሁት፥ ይፈረድበት ዘንድ ይገባ ነበርና።

verses.en: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.fr: En effet, avant l''arrivée de quelques personnes envoyées par Jacques, il mangeait avec les païens; et, quand elles furent venues, il s''esquiva et se tint à l''écart, par crainte des circoncis.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ከያዕቆብ ዘንድ ሳይመጡ ከአሕዛብ ጋር አብሮ ይበላ ነበርና፤ በመጡ ጊዜ ግን ከተገረዙት ወገን ያሉትን ፈርቶ ያፈገፍግ ነበርና ከእነርሱ ተለየ።

verses.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.fr: Avec lui les autres Juifs usèrent aussi de dissimulation, en sorte que Barnabas même fut entraîné par leur hypocrisie.
verses.am: የቀሩትም አይሁድ ደግሞ፥ በርናባስ ስንኳ በግብዝነታቸው እስከ ተሳበ ድረስ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ግብዞች ሆኑ።

verses.en: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.fr: Voyant qu''ils ne marchaient pas droit selon la vérité de l''Evangile, je dis à Céphas, en présence de tous: Si toi qui es Juif, tu vis à la manière des païens et non à la manière des Juifs, pourquoi forces-tu les païens à judaïser?
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ወንጌል እውነት በቅንነት እንዳልሄዱ ባየሁ ጊዜ በሁሉ ፊት ኬፋን። አንተ አይሁዳዊ ሳለህ በአይሁድ ኑሮ ያይደለ በአሕዛብ ኑሮ ብትኖር፥ አሕዛብ በአይሁድ ኑሮ ሊኖሩ እንዴት ግድ አልሃቸው? አልሁት።

verses.en: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.fr: Nous, nous sommes Juifs de naissance, et non pécheurs d''entre les païens.
verses.am: እኛ በፍጥረት አይሁድ ነን ኃጢአተኞችም የሆኑ አሕዛብ አይደለንም፤

verses.en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.fr: Néanmoins, sachant que ce n''est pas par les oeuvres de la loi que l''homme est justifié, mais par la foi en Jésus-Christ, nous aussi nous avons cru en Jésus-Christ, afin d''être justifiés par la foi en Christ et non par les oeuvres de la loi, parce que nulle chair ne sera justifiée par les oeuvres de la loi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በማመን እንዲጸድቅ እንጂ በሕግ ሥራ እንዳይሆን አውቀን፥ ሥጋን የለበሰ ሁሉ በሕግ ሥራ ስለማይጸድቅ፥ እኛ ራሳችን በሕግ ሥራ ሳይሆን በክርስቶስ እምነት እንጸድቅ ዘንድ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አምነናል።

verses.en: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.fr: Mais, tandis que nous cherchons à être justifiés par Christ, si nous étions aussi nous-mêmes trouvés pécheurs, Christ serait-il un ministre du péché? Loin de là!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በክርስቶስ ልንጸድቅ የምንፈልግ ስንሆን ራሳችን ደግሞ ኃጢአተኞች ሆነን ከተገኘን፥ እንግዲያስ ክርስቶስ የኃጢአት አገልጋይ ነዋ? አይደለም።

verses.en: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.fr: Car, si je rebâtis les choses que j''ai détruites, je me constitue moi-même un transgresseur,
verses.am: ያፈረስሁትን ይህን እንደ ገና የማንጽ ከሆንሁ ራሴ ሕግ ተላላፊ እንድሆን አስረዳለሁና።

verses.en: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.fr: car c''est par la loi que je suis mort à la loi, afin de vivre pour Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ ለእግዚአብሔር ሕያው ሆኜ እኖር ዘንድ በሕግ በኩል ለሕግ ሞቼ ነበርና።

verses.en: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.fr: J''ai été crucifié avec Christ; et si je vis, ce n''est plus moi qui vis, c''est Christ qui vit en moi; si je vis maintenant dans la chair, je vis dans la foi au Fils de Dieu, qui m''a aimé et qui s''est livré lui-même pour moi.
verses.am: ከክርስቶስ ጋር ተሰቅዬአለሁ፤ እኔም አሁን ሕያው ሆኜ አልኖርም ክርስቶስ ግን በእኔ ይኖራል፤ አሁንም በሥጋ የምኖርበት ኑሮ በወደደኝና ስለ እኔ ራሱን በሰጠው በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ላይ ባለ እምነት የምኖረው ነው።

verses.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verses.fr: Je ne rejette pas la grâce de Dieu; car si la justice s''obtient par la loi, Christ est donc mort en vain.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ አልጥልም፤ ጽድቅስ በሕግ በኩል ከሆነ እንኪያስ ክርስቶስ በከንቱ ሞተ።

verses.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.fr: O Galates, dépourvus de sens! qui vous a fascinés, vous, aux yeux de qui Jésus-Christ a été peint comme crucifié?
verses.am: የማታስተውሉ የገላትያ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ በዓይናችሁ ፊት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እንደ ተሰቀለ ሆኖ ተሥሎ ነበር፤ ለእውነት እንዳትታዘዙ አዚም ያደረገባችሁ ማን ነው?

verses.en: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.fr: Voici seulement ce que je veux apprendre de vous: Est-ce par les oeuvres de la loi que vous avez reçu l''Esprit, ou par la prédication de la foi?
verses.am: ይህን ብቻ ከእናንተ እንድማር እወዳለሁ፤ በሕግ ሥራ ወይም ከእምነት ጋር በሆነ መስማት መንፈስን ተቀበላችሁን?

verses.en: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.fr: Etes-vous tellement dépourvus de sens? Après avoir commencé par l''Esprit, voulez-vous maintenant finir par la chair?
verses.am: እንዲህን የማታስተውሉ ናችሁ? በመንፈስ ጀምራችሁ አሁን በሥጋ ትፈጽማላችሁን?

verses.en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.fr: Avez-vous tant souffert en vain? si toutefois c''est en vain.
verses.am: በውኑ ከንቱ እንደ ሆነስ እንደዚህ ያለ መከራ በከንቱ ተቀበላችሁን?

verses.en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.fr: Celui qui vous accorde l''Esprit, et qui opère des miracles parmi vous, le fait-il donc par les oeuvres de la loi, ou par la prédication de la foi?
verses.am: እንግዲህ መንፈስን የሚሰጣችሁ በእናንተም ዘንድ ተአምራት የሚያደርግ፥ በሕግ ሥራ ነውን ወይስ ከእምነት ጋር በሆነ መስማት ነው?

verses.en: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.fr: Comme Abraham crut à Dieu, et que cela lui fut imputé à justice,
verses.am: እንዲሁ አብርሃም በእግዚአብሔር አመነና ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።

verses.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.fr: reconnaissez donc que ce sont ceux qui ont la foi qui sont fils d''Abraham.
verses.am: እንኪያስ ከእምነት የሆኑት እነዚህ የአብርሃም ልጆች እንደ ሆኑ እወቁ።

verses.en: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.fr: Aussi l''Ecriture, prévoyant que Dieu justifierait les païens par la foi, a d''avance annoncé cette bonne nouvelle à Abraham: Toutes les nations seront bénies en toi!
verses.am: መጽሐፍም እግዚአብሔር አሕዛብን በእምነት እንዲያጸድቅ አስቀድሞ አይቶ። በአንተ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይባረካሉ ብሎ ወንጌልን ለአብርሃም አስቀድሞ ሰበከ።

verses.en: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.fr: de sorte que ceux qui croient sont bénis avec Abraham le croyant.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ከእምነት የሆኑት ካመነው ከአብርሃም ጋር ይባረካሉ።

verses.en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.fr: Car tous ceux qui s''attachent aux oeuvres de la loi sont sous la malédiction; car il est écrit: Maudit est quiconque n''observe pas tout ce qui est écrit dans le livre de la loi, et ne le met pas en pratique.
verses.am: ከሕግ ሥራ የሆኑት ሁሉ በእርግማን በታች ናቸውና፤ በሕግ መጽሐፍ በተጻፉት ሁሉ ጸንቶ የማይኖር የማያደርግም ሁሉ የተረገመ ነው ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.fr: Et que nul ne soit justifié devant Dieu par la loi, cela est évident, puisqu''il est dit: Le juste vivra par la foi.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በእምነት ይኖራል ተብሎአልና ማንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕግ እንዳይጸድቅ ግልጥ ነው።

verses.en: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.fr: Or, la loi ne procède pas de la foi; mais elle dit: Celui qui mettra ces choses en pratique vivra par elles.
verses.am: ሕግም ከእምነት አይደለም ነገር ግን። የሚያደርገው ይኖርበታል ተብሎአል።

verses.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.fr: Christ nous a rachetés de la malédiction de la loi, étant devenu malédiction pour nous-car il est écrit: Maudit est quiconque est pendu au bois, -
verses.am: በእንጨት የሚሰቀል ሁሉ የተረገመ ነው ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና ክርስቶስ ስለ እኛ እርግማን ሆኖ ከሕግ እርግማን ዋጀን፤

verses.en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.fr: afin que la bénédiction d''Abraham eût pour les païens son accomplissement en Jésus-Christ, et que nous reçussions par la foi l''Esprit qui avait été promis.
verses.am: የመንፈስን ተስፋ በእምነት እንድንቀበል፥ የአብርሃም በረከት ወደ አሕዛብ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ይደርስላቸው ዘንድ።

verses.en: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.fr: Frères je parle à la manière des hommes, une disposition en bonne forme, bien que faite par un homme, n''est annulée par personne, et personne n''y ajoute.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ። የሰው ስንኳ ቢሆን እርግጠኛውን ኪዳን ማንም አይንቅም ወይም አይጨምርበትም።

verses.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.fr: Or les promesses ont été faites à Abraham et à sa postérité. Il n''est pas dit: et aux postérités, comme s''il s''agissait de plusieurs, mais en tant qu''il s''agit d''une seule: et à ta postérité, c''est-à-dire, à Christ.
verses.am: ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩም የተስፋው ቃል ተነገረ። ስለ ብዙዎች እንደሚነገር። ለዘሮቹም አይልም፤ ስለ አንድ እንደሚነገር ግን። ለዘርህም ይላል፥ እርሱም ክርስቶስ።

verses.en: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.fr: Voici ce que j''entends: une disposition, que Dieu a confirmée antérieurement, ne peut pas être annulée, et ainsi la promesse rendue vaine, par la loi survenue quatre cent trente ans plus tard.
verses.am: ይህንም እላለሁ፤ ከአራት መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት በኋላ የተሰጠው ሕግ አስቀድሞ በእግዚአብሔር የተረጋገጠውን ኪዳን የተስፋውን ቃል እስኪሽር ድረስ አያፈርስም።

verses.en: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.fr: Car si l''héritage venait de la loi, il ne viendrait plus de la promesse; or, c''est par la promesse que Dieu a fait à Abraham ce don de sa grâce.
verses.am: ርስቱ በሕግ ቢሆንስ እንግዲያስ በተስፋ ቃል አይሆንም፤ በተስፋ ቃል ግን እግዚአብሔር ለአብርሃም ሰጥቶአል።

verses.en: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.fr: Pourquoi donc la loi? Elle a été donnée ensuite à cause des transgressions, jusqu''à ce que vînt la postérité à qui la promesse avait été faite; elle a été promulguée par des anges, au moyen d''un médiateur.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕግ ምንድር ነው? ተስፋው የተሰጠው ዘር እስኪመጣ ድረስ በመካከለኛ እጅ በመላእክት በኩል ስለ ሕግ መተላለፍ ተጨመረ።

verses.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.fr: Or, le médiateur n''est pas médiateur d''un seul, tandis que Dieu est un seul.
verses.am: መካከለኛውም ለአንድ ብቻ አይደለም እግዚአብሔር ግን አንድ ነው።

verses.en: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.fr: La loi est-elle donc contre les promesses de Dieu? Loin de là! S''il eût été donné une loi qui pût procurer la vie, la justice viendrait réellement de la loi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕግ የእግዚአብሔርን የተስፋ ቃል የሚቃወም ነውን? አይደለም። ሕያው ሊያደርግ የሚቻለው ሕግ ተሰጥቶ ቢሆንስ በእውነት ጽድቅ ከሕግ በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.fr: Mais l''Ecriture a tout renfermé sous le péché, afin que ce qui avait été promis fût donné par la foi en Jésus-Christ à ceux qui croient.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከማመን የሆነው የተስፋ ቃል ለሚያምኑ ይሰጥ ዘንድ መጽሐፍ ከኃጢአት በታች ሁሉን ዘግቶታል።

verses.en: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.fr: Avant que la foi vînt, nous étions enfermés sous la garde de la loi, en vue de la foi qui devait être révélée.
verses.am: እምነትም ሳይመጣ ሊገለጥ ላለው እምነት ተዘግተን ከሕግ በታች እንጠበቅ ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.fr: Ainsi la loi a été comme un pédagogue pour nous conduire à Christ, afin que nous fussions justifiés par la foi.
verses.am: እንደዚህ በእምነት እንጸድቅ ዘንድ ሕግ ወደ ክርስቶስ የሚያመጣ ሞግዚታችን ሆኖአል፤

verses.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.fr: La foi étant venue, nous ne sommes plus sous ce pédagogue.
verses.am: እምነት ግን መጥቶአልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ከሞግዚት በታች አይደለንም።

verses.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Car vous êtes tous fils de Dieu par la foi en Jésus-Christ;
verses.am: በእምነት በኩል ሁላችሁ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናችሁና፤

verses.en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.fr: vous tous, qui avez été baptisés en Christ, vous avez revêtu Christ.
verses.am: ከክርስቶስ ጋር አንድ ትሆኑ ዘንድ የተጠመቃችሁ ሁሉ ክርስቶስን ለብሳችኋልና።

verses.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Il n''y a plus ni Juif ni Grec, il n''y a plus ni esclave ni libre, il n''y a plus ni homme ni femme; car tous vous êtes un en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: አይሁዳዊ ወይም የግሪክ ሰው የለም፥ ባሪያ ወይም ጨዋ ሰው የለም፥ ወንድም ሴትም የለም፤ ሁላችሁ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አንድ ሰው ናችሁና።

verses.en: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.fr: Et si vous êtes à Christ, vous êtes donc la postérité d''Abraham, héritiers selon la promesse.
verses.am: እናንተም የክርስቶስ ከሆናችሁ እንኪያስ የአብርሃም ዘር እንደ ተስፋውም ቃል ወራሾች ናችሁ።

verses.en: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.fr: Or, aussi longtemps que l''héritier est enfant, je dis qu''il ne diffère en rien d''un esclave, quoiqu''il soit le maître de tout;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላለሁ፥ ወራሹ ሕፃን ሆኖ ባለበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ምንም የሁሉ ጌታ ቢሆን ከቶ ከባሪያ አይለይም፥

verses.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.fr: mais il est sous des tuteurs et des administrateurs jusqu''au temps marqué par le père.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አባቱ እስከ ቀጠረለት ቀን ድረስ ከጠባቂዎችና ከመጋቢዎች በታች ነው።

verses.en: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.fr: Nous aussi, de la même manière, lorsque nous étions enfants, nous étions sous l''esclavage des rudiments du monde;
verses.am: እንዲሁ እኛ ደግሞ ሕፃናት ሆነን ሳለን ከዓለም መጀመሪያ ትምህርት በታች ተገዝተን ባሪያዎች ነበርን፤

verses.en: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.fr: mais, lorsque les temps ont été accomplis, Dieu a envoyé son Fils, né d''une femme, né sous la loi,
verses.am: ነገር ግን የዘመኑ ፍጻሜ በደረሰ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከሴት የተወለደውን ከሕግም በታች የተወለደውን ልጁን ላከ፤

verses.en: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.fr: afin qu''il rachetât ceux qui étaient sous la loi, afin que nous reçussions l''adoption.
verses.am: እንደ ልጆች እንሆን ዘንድ፥ ከሕግ በታች ያሉትን ይዋጅ ዘንድ።

verses.en: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.fr: Et parce que vous êtes fils, Dieu a envoyé dans nos coeurs l''Esprit de son Fils, lequel crie: Abba! Père!
verses.am: ልጆችም ስለ ሆናችሁ እግዚአብሔር አባ አባት ብሎ የሚጮኽ የልጁን መንፈስ በልባችሁ ውስጥ ላከ።

verses.en: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.fr: Ainsi tu n''es plus esclave, mais fils; et si tu es fils, tu es aussi héritier par la grâce de Dieu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ልጅ ነህ እንጂ ባሪያ አይደለህም፤ ልጅም ከሆንህ ደግሞ በክርስቶስ የእግዚአብሔር ወራሽ ነህ።

verses.en: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.fr: Autrefois, ne connaissant pas Dieu, vous serviez des dieux qui ne le sont pas de leur nature;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያን ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ሳታውቁ በባሕርያቸው አማልክት ለማይሆኑ ባሪያዎች ሆናችሁ ተገዛችሁ፤

verses.en: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
verses.fr: mais à présent que vous avez connu Dieu, ou plutôt que vous avez été connus de Dieu, comment retournez-vous à ces faibles et pauvres rudiments, auxquels de nouveau vous voulez vous asservir encore?
verses.am: አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔርን ስታውቁ ይልቅስ በእግዚአብሔር ስትታወቁ እንደ ገና ወደ ደካማ ወደሚናቅም ወደ መጀመሪያ ትምህርት እንዴት ትመለሳላችሁ? እንደ ገና ባሪያዎች ሆናችሁ ዳግመኛ ለዚያ ልትገዙ ትወዳላችሁን?

verses.en: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.fr: Vous observez les jours, les mois, les temps et les années!
verses.am: ቀንንና ወርን ዘመንንም ዓመትንም በጥንቃቄ ትጠብቃላችሁ።

verses.en: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.fr: Je crains d''avoir inutilement travaillé pour vous.
verses.am: ምናልባት በከንቱ ለእናንተ ደክሜአለሁ ብዬ እፈራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.fr: Soyez comme moi, car moi aussi je suis comme vous. Frères, je vous en supplie. Vous ne m''avez fait aucun tort.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ ሆኜአለሁና። እንደ እኔ ሁኑ ብዬ እለምናችኋለሁ። አንዳችም አልበደላችሁኝም።

verses.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.fr: Vous savez que ce fut à cause d''une infirmité de la chair que je vous ai pour la première fois annoncé l''Evangile.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ወንጌልን በሰበክሁላችሁ ጊዜ ከሥጋ ድካም የተነሣ እንደ ነበረ ታውቃላችሁ፥

verses.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Et mis à l''épreuve par ma chair, vous n''avez témoigné ni mépris ni dégoût; vous m''avez, au contraire, reçu comme un ange de Dieu, comme Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በሥጋዬም ፈተና የሆነባችሁን ነገር አልናቃችሁትምና አልተጸየፋችሁትም ነገር ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ አዎን እንደ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተቀበላችሁኝ።

verses.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.fr: Où donc est l''expression de votre bonheur? Car je vous atteste que, si cela eût été possible, vous vous seriez arraché les yeux pour me les donner.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ደስ ማሰኘታችሁ ወዴት አለ? ቢቻልስ ዓይኖቻችሁን አውጥታችሁ በሰጣችሁኝ ብዬ እመሰክርላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.fr: Suis-je devenu votre ennemi en vous disant la vérité?
verses.am: እንኪያስ እውነቱን ስለ ነገርኋችሁ ጠላት ሆንሁባችሁን?

verses.en: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
verses.fr: Le zèle qu''ils ont pour vous n''est pas pur, mais ils veulent vous détacher de nous, afin que vous soyez zélés pour eux.
verses.am: በብርቱ ይፈልጉአችኋል፥ ለመልካም አይደለም ነገር ግን በብርቱ ትፈልጉአቸው ዘንድ በውጭ ሊያስቀሩአችሁ ይወዳሉ።

verses.en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.fr: Il est beau d''avoir du zèle pour ce qui est bien et en tout temps, et non pas seulement quand je suis présent parmi vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ዘንድ በምኖርበት ጊዜ ብቻ ሳይሆን ሁልጊዜ በመልካም ነገር ተፈላጊ ብትሆኑ መልካም ነው።

verses.en: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.fr: Mes enfants, pour qui j''éprouve de nouveau les douleurs de l''enfantement, jusqu''à ce que Christ soit formé en vous,
verses.am: ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ ክርስቶስ በእናንተ እስኪሣል ድረስ ዳግመኛ ስለ እናንተ ምጥ ይዞኛል።

verses.en: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.fr: je voudrais être maintenant auprès de vous, et changer de langage, car je suis dans l''inquiétude à votre sujet.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ አመነታለሁና አሁን በእናንተ ዘንድ ሆኜ ድምፄን ልለውጥ በወደድሁ።

verses.en: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.fr: Dites-moi, vous qui voulez être sous la loi, n''entendez-vous point la loi?
verses.am: እናንተ ከሕግ በታች ልትኖሩ የምትወዱ፥ ሕጉን አትሰሙምን? እስኪ ንገሩኝ።

verses.en: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.fr: Car il est écrit qu''Abraham eut deux fils, un de la femme esclave, et un de la femme libre.
verses.am: አንዱ ከባሪያይቱ አንዱም ከጨዋይቱ የሆኑ ሁለት ልጆች ለአብርሃም እንደ ነበሩት ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.fr: Mais celui de l''esclave naquit selon la chair, et celui de la femme libre naquit en vertu de la promesse.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የባሪያይቱ ልጅ እንደ ሥጋ ተወልዶአል፥ የጨዋይቱ ግን በተስፋው ቃል ተወልዶአል።

verses.en: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.fr: Ces choses sont allégoriques; car ces femmes sont deux alliances. L''une du mont Sinaï, enfantant pour la servitude, c''est Agar, -
verses.am: ይህም ነገር ምሳሌ ነው፤ እነዚህ ሴቶች እንደ ሁለቱ ኪዳኖች ናቸውና። ከደብረ ሲና የሆነችው አንዲቱ ለባርነት ልጆችን ትወልዳለች፥ እርስዋም አጋር ናት።

verses.en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.fr: car Agar, c''est le mont Sinaï en Arabie, -et elle correspond à la Jérusalem actuelle, qui est dans la servitude avec ses enfants.
verses.am: ይህችም አጋር በዓረብ ምድር ያለችው ደብረ ሲና ናት፤ አሁንም ያለችውን ኢየሩሳሌምን ትመስላለች፥ ከልጆችዋ ጋር በባርነት ናትና።

verses.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.fr: Mais la Jérusalem d''en haut est libre, c''est notre mère;
verses.am: ላይኛይቱ ኢየሩሳሌም ግን በነጻነት የምትኖር ናት እርስዋም እናታችን ናት።

verses.en: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.fr: car il est écrit: Réjouis-toi, stérile, toi qui n''enfantes point! Eclate et pousse des cris, toi qui n''as pas éprouvé les douleurs de l''enfantement! Car les enfants de la délaissée seront plus nombreux Que les enfants de celle qui était mariée.
verses.am: አንቺ የማትወልጅ መካን፥ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ አንቺ አምጠሽ የማታውቂ፥ እልል በዪና ጩኺ፤ ባል ካላቱ ይልቅ የብቸኛይቱ ልጆች በዝተዋልና ተብሎ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.fr: Pour vous, frères, comme Isaac, vous êtes enfants de la promesse;
verses.am: እኛም፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንደ ይስሐቅ የተስፋ ቃል ልጆች ነን።

verses.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.fr: et de même qu''alors celui qui était né selon la chair persécutait celui qui était né selon l''Esprit, ainsi en est-il encore maintenant.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ሥጋ የተወለደው እንደ መንፈስ የተወለደውን በዚያን ጊዜ እንዳሳደደው ዛሬም እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.fr: Mais que dit l''Ecriture? Chasse l''esclave et son fils, car le fils de l''esclave n''héritera pas avec le fils de la femme libre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ ምን ይላል? የባሪያይቱ ልጅ ከጨዋይቱ ልጅ ጋር አይወርስምና ባሪያይቱን ከልጅዋ ጋር አውጣት።

verses.en: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, frères, nous ne sommes pas enfants de l''esclave, mais de la femme libre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የጨዋይቱ ልጆች ነን እንጂ የባሪያይቱ አይደለንም።

verses.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.fr: C''est pour la liberté que Christ nous a affranchis. Demeurez donc fermes, et ne vous laissez pas mettre de nouveau sous le joug de la servitude.
verses.am: በነጻነት ልንኖር ክርስቶስ ነጻነት አወጣን፤ እንግዲህ ጸንታችሁ ቁሙ እንደ ገናም በባርነት ቀንበር አትያዙ።

verses.en: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.fr: Voici, moi Paul, je vous dis que, si vous vous faites circoncire, Christ ne vous servira de rien.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ ጳውሎስ እላችኋለሁ። ብትገረዙ ክርስቶስ ምንም አይጠቅማችሁም።

verses.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.fr: Et je proteste encore une fois à tout homme qui se fait circoncire, qu''il est tenu de pratiquer la loi tout entière.
verses.am: ሕግንም ሁሉ እንዲፈጽም ግድ አለበት ብዬ ለሚገረዙት ሁሉ ለእያንዳንዶች ደግሜ እመሰክራለሁ።

verses.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.fr: Vous êtes séparés de Christ, vous tous qui cherchez la justification dans la loi; vous êtes déchus de la grâce.
verses.am: በሕግ ልትጸድቁ የምትፈልጉ ከክርስቶስ ተለይታችሁ ከጸጋው ወድቃችኋል።

verses.en: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.fr: Pour nous, c''est de la foi que nous attendons, par l''Esprit, l''espérance de la justice.
verses.am: እኛ በመንፈስ ከእምነት የጽድቅን ተስፋ እንጠባበቃለንና።

verses.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.fr: Car, en Jésus-Christ, ni la circoncision ni l''incirconcision n''a de valeur, mais la foi qui est agissante par la charité.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሆኖ፥ በፍቅር የሚሠራ እምነት እንጂ መገረዝ ቢሆን ወይም አለመገረዝ አይጠቅምምና።

verses.en: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.fr: Vous couriez bien: qui vous a arrêtés, pour vous empêcher d''obéir à la vérité?
verses.am: በመልካም ትሮጡ ነበር፤ ለእውነት እንዳትታዘዙ ማን ከለከላችሁ?

verses.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.fr: Cette influence ne vient pas de celui qui vous appelle.
verses.am: ይህ ማባበል ከሚጠራችሁ አልወጣም። ጥቂት እርሾ ሊጡን ሁሉ ያቦካል።

verses.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.fr: Un peu de levain fait lever toute la pâte.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ገና እስከ አሁን መገረዝን ብሰብክ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ለምን ያሳድዱኛል? እንኪያስ የመስቀል ዕንቅፋት ተወግዶአል።

verses.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.fr: J''ai cette confiance en vous, dans le Seigneur, que vous ne penserez pas autrement. Mais celui qui vous trouble, quel qu''il soit, en portera la peine.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ገና እስከ አሁን መገረዝን ብሰብክ እስከ አሁን ድረስ ለምን ያሳድዱኛል? እንኪያስ የመስቀል ዕንቅፋት ተወግዶአል።

verses.en: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.fr: Pour moi, frères, si je prêche encore la circoncision, pourquoi suis-je encore persécuté? Le scandale de la croix a donc disparu!
verses.am: የሚያውኩአችሁ ይቆረጡ።

verses.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.fr: Puissent-ils être retranchés, ceux qui mettent le trouble parmi vous!
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ለአርነት ተጠርታችኋልና፤ ብቻ አርነታችሁ ለሥጋ ምክንያትን አይስጥ፥ ነገር ግን በፍቅር እርስ በርሳችሁ እንደ ባሪያዎች ሁኑ።

verses.en: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.fr: Frères, vous avez été appelés à la liberté, seulement ne faites pas de cette liberté un prétexte de vivre selon la chair; mais rendez-vous, par la charité, serviteurs les uns des autres.
verses.am: ሕግ ሁሉ በአንድ ቃል ይፈጸማልና፥ እርሱም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ የሚል ነው።

verses.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.fr: Car toute la loi est accomplie dans une seule parole, dans celle-ci: Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እርስ በርሳችሁ ብትነካከሱ ብትበላሉ እርስ በርሳችሁ እንዳትጠፋፉ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.fr: Mais si vous vous mordez et vous dévorez les uns les autres, prenez garde que vous ne soyez détruits les uns par les autres.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላለሁ፥ በመንፈስ ተመላለሱ፥ የሥጋንም ምኞት ከቶ አትፈጽሙ።

verses.en: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.fr: Je dis donc: Marchez selon l''Esprit, et vous n''accomplirez pas les désirs de la chair.
verses.am: ሥጋ በመንፈስ ላይ መንፈስም በሥጋ ላይ ይመኛልና፥ እነዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው ይቀዋወማሉ፤ ስለዚህም የምትወዱትን ልታደርጉ አትችሉም።

verses.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.fr: Car la chair a des désirs contraires à ceux de l''Esprit, et l''Esprit en a de contraires à ceux de la chair; ils sont opposés entre eux, afin que vous ne fassiez point ce que vous voudriez.
verses.am: በመንፈስ ብትመሩ ግን ከሕግ በታች አይደላችሁም።

verses.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.fr: Si vous êtes conduits par l''Esprit, vous n''êtes point sous la loi.
verses.am: የሥጋ ሥራም የተገለጠ ነው እርሱም ዝሙት፥ ርኵሰት፥

verses.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.fr: Or, les oeuvres de la chair sont manifestes, ce sont l''impudicité, l''impureté, la dissolution,
verses.am: መዳራት፥ ጣዖትን ማምለክ፥ ምዋርት፥ ጥል፥ ክርክር፥ ቅንዓት፥ ቁጣ፥ አድመኛነት፥

verses.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.fr: l''idolâtrie, la magie, les inimitiés, les querelles, les jalousies, les animosités, les disputes, les divisions, les sectes,
verses.am: መለያየት፥ መናፍቅነት፥ ምቀኝነት፥ መግደል፥ ስካር፥ ዘፋኝነት፥ ይህንም የሚመስል ነው። አስቀድሜም እንዳልሁ፥ እንደዚህ ያሉትን የሚያደርጉ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት አይወርሱም።

verses.en: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: l''envie, l''ivrognerie, les excès de table, et les choses semblables. Je vous dis d''avance, comme je l''ai déjà dit, que ceux qui commettent de telles choses n''hériteront point le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: የመንፈስ ፍሬ ግን ፍቅር፥ ደስታ፥ ሰላም፥ ትዕግሥት፥ ቸርነት፥ በጎነት፥ እምነት፥ የውሃት፥ ራስን መግዛት ነው።

verses.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.fr: Mais le fruit de l''Esprit, c''est l''amour, la joie, la paix, la patience, la bonté, la bénignité, la fidélité,
verses.am: እንደዚህ ያሉትን የሚከለክል ሕግ የለም።

verses.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.fr: la douceur, la tempérance; la loi n''est pas contre ces choses.
verses.am: የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም የሆኑቱ ሥጋን ከክፉ መሻቱና ከምኞቱ ጋር ሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont à Jésus-Christ ont crucifié la chair avec ses passions et ses désirs.
verses.am: በመንፈስ ብንኖር በመንፈስ ደግሞ እንመላለስ።

verses.en: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.fr: Si nous vivons par l''Esprit, marchons aussi selon l''Esprit.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችን እየተነሣሣንና እየተቀናናን በከንቱ አንመካ።

verses.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.fr: Ne cherchons pas une vaine gloire, en nous provoquant les uns les autres, en nous portant envie les uns aux autres.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችን እየተነሣሣንና እየተቀናናን በከንቱ አንመካ።

verses.en: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.fr: Frères, si un homme vient à être surpris en quelque faute, vous qui êtes spirituels, redressez-le avec un esprit de douceur. Prends garde à toi-même, de peur que tu ne sois aussi tenté.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሰው በማናቸውም በደል ስንኳ ቢገኝ፥ መንፈሳውያን የሆናችሁ እናንተ እንደዚህ ያለውን ሰው በየውሃት መንፈስ አቅኑት፤ አንተ ደግሞ እንዳትፈተን ራስህን ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.fr: Portez les fardeaux les uns des autres, et vous accomplirez ainsi la loi de Christ.
verses.am: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ የአንዱን ሸክም ይሸከም እንዲሁም የክርስቶስን ሕግ ፈጽሙ።

verses.en: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un pense être quelque chose, quoiqu''il ne soit rien, il s''abuse lui-même.
verses.am: አንዱ ምንም ሳይሆን ምንም የሆነ ቢመስለው ራሱን ያታልላልና።

verses.en: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.fr: Que chacun examine ses propres oeuvres, et alors il aura sujet de se glorifier pour lui seul, et non par rapport à autrui;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ራሱን ሥራ ይፈትን፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ስለ ሌላው ሰው ያልሆነ ስለ ራሱ ብቻ የሚመካበትን ያገኛል፤

verses.en: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.fr: car chacun portera son propre fardeau.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ የገዛ ራሱን ሸክም ሊሸከም ነውና።

verses.en: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.fr: Que celui à qui l''on enseigne la parole fasse part de tous ses biens à celui qui l''enseigne.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቃሉን የሚማር ከሚያስተምረው ጋር መልካምን ነገር ሁሉ ይከፋፈል።

verses.en: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.fr: Ne vous y trompez pas: on ne se moque pas de Dieu. Ce qu''un homme aura semé, il le moissonnera aussi.
verses.am: አትሳቱ፤ እግዚአብሔር አይዘበትበትም። ሰው የሚዘራውን ሁሉ ያንኑ ደግሞ ያጭዳልና፤

verses.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.fr: Celui qui sème pour sa chair moissonnera de la chair la corruption; mais celui qui sème pour l''Esprit moissonnera de l''Esprit la vie éternelle.
verses.am: በገዛ ሥጋው የሚዘራ ከሥጋ መበስበስን ያጭዳልና፥ በመንፈስ ግን የሚዘራው ከመንፈስ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ያጭዳል።

verses.en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.fr: Ne nous lassons pas de faire le bien; car nous moissonnerons au temps convenable, si nous ne nous relâchons pas.
verses.am: ባንዝልም በጊዜው እናጭዳለንና መልካም ሥራን ለመሥራት አንታክት።

verses.en: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, pendant que nous en avons l''occasion, pratiquons le bien envers tous, et surtout envers les frères en la foi.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ ጊዜ ካገኘን ዘንድ ለሰው ሁሉ ይልቁንም ለሃይማኖት ቤተ ሰዎች መልካም እናድርግ።

verses.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.fr: Voyez avec quelles grandes lettres je vous ai écrit de ma propre main.
verses.am: እንዴት ባሉ ታላላቆች ፊደላት በእጄ እንደ ጻፍሁላችሁ እዩ።

verses.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui veulent se rendre agréables selon la chair vous contraignent à vous faire circoncire, uniquement afin de n''être pas persécutés pour la croix de Christ.
verses.am: በሥጋ መልካም ሆነው ሊታዩ የሚወዱ ሁሉ እንድትገረዙ ግድ አሉአችሁ፥ ነገር ግን ስለ ክርስቶስ መስቀል እንዳይሰደዱ ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.fr: Car les circoncis eux-mêmes n''observent point la loi; mais ils veulent que vous soyez circoncis, pour se glorifier dans votre chair.
verses.am: በሥጋችሁ እንዲመኩ ልትገረዙ ይወዳሉ እንጂ የተገረዙቱ ራሳቸው እንኳ ሕግን አይጠብቁም።

verses.en: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui me concerne, loin de moi la pensée de me glorifier d''autre chose que de la croix de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, par qui le monde est crucifié pour moi, comme je le suis pour le monde!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዓለም ለእኔ የተሰቀለበት እኔም ለዓለም የተሰቀልሁበት ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መስቀል በቀር ሌላ ትምክህት ከእኔ ይራቅ።

verses.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est rien que d''être circoncis ou incirconcis; ce qui est quelque chose, c''est d''être une nouvelle créature.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አዲስ ፍጥረት መሆን ይጠቅማል እንጂ መገረዝ ቢሆን ወይም አለመገረዝ አይጠቅምምና።

verses.en: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.fr: Paix et miséricorde sur tous ceux qui suivront cette règle, et sur l''Israël de Dieu!
verses.am: በዚህም ሥርዓት በሚመላለሱ ሁሉ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር እስራኤልም ላይ ሰላምና ምሕረት ይሁን።

verses.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: Que personne désormais ne me fasse de la peine, car je porte sur mon corps les marques de Jésus.
verses.am: እኔ የኢየሱስን ማኅተም በሥጋዬ ተሸክሜአለሁና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አንድ ስንኳ አያድክመኝ።

verses.en: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.fr: Frères, que la grâce de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ soit avec votre esprit! Amen!
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከመንፈሳችሁ ጋር ይሁን። አሜን።
